1,Despotism Justifies the Means: Bad guys who want only power and will do anything to achieve it
1,Dismotivation: Characters try hard to achieve nothing.
1,Driven By Envy: A character wants something someone else has, and resents them for it.
1,Dystopia Justifies The Means: Bad guys whose goal is to create a nightmarish Crapsack World.
1,Embodiment Of Virtue: A character is driven by the desire to achieve perfection in a certain moral virtue.

1,For Great Justice: Good guys fight so that Justice Will Prevail.
1,For Happiness: A character wants to spread joy and cheer.
1,For Science!: A character wants to make scientific discoveries with no real practical purposes.
1,For the Funnyz: A character makes a joke, usually against their own self-interest, because they love jokes.
1,The Four Loves: A character searches for love, in any form.
1,Freudian Excuse: Something in a characters past causes them to act the way they do, often parental abuse.
1,Glory Seeker: A character wants other people to consider him/her to be a Badass.

1,Gotta Catch Them All: A character wants to pursue a collection.

1,Humble Goal: A character wants to do or have something that happens to be simple.
1,I Just Want To Be Badass: A character wants to be strong.
1,I Just Want To Be Beautiful: A character wants to remain or become beautiful.
1,I Just Want To Be Free: A character wants freedom from some sort of bondage.

1,I Just Want to Be Special: A character living a mundane life wants to be more exciting.
1,I Just Want to Be You: A character wants to be literally the person they envy.
1,I Just Want to Have Friends: A character or a person who wants friends.
1,In Harm's Way: Characters want excitement and danger in their lives.
1,I Owe You My Life: A character feels indebted to someone who saved their life.
1,It Amused Me: A character who acts purely for their own entertainment.

1,They Called Me Mad!: A character is motivated by the mockery he's received in the past.
1,Trapped In Villainy: A villain only performs villainous acts because, if they dont, they'll die.
